name: Tymna the Weaver
description: A blind Theran mortal who mastered the magic of the Fates after a career as one of the Battlewise of Meletis.

timeline.summary: A chariot accident blinds Tymna and ends her career among the Battlewise of Meletis.
timeline.quote: A career filled with victories was cut short by a chariot accident, leaving her blind.
